After the expiration of thirty days from the issuance of this Order, all the above-described
articles entered or withdrawn from warehouse in the Philippines for consumption shall be subject to the rates
of import duty herein prescribed.

Any unwarranted increase in the prices of local products benefitted by these tariff changes shall
be sufficient ground for the revocation of such tariff changes.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
